responses.raw_response: 1. For the Mathverse benchmark, PPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy at 62%. This is followed closely by DAPO+Self-reflection at 60% and DAPO at 58%. GRPO and SRPO have lower accuracies at 57% and 52%, respectively. 2. In the MMLU benchmark, PPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy at 59%. DAPO+Self-reflection is second at 57% and DAPO at 55%. GRPO and SRPO have the lowest accuracies at 54% and 50%, respectively. PPO achieves an accuracy of 53%. Thus, in this benchmark, the best-performing method is PPO+Self-reflection, not GRPO, and all the other methods except SRPO underperform. 3. In the Physics benchmark, the DAPO+Self-reflection method achieves the highest accuracy at 61%, making it the most accurate method. The methods in order of lowest to highest accuracy are SRPO (57%), SRPO/Self-reflection (56%), PPO (54%), DAPO (52%), DAPO+Self-reflection (60%), and GRPO (58%). Liam's uncle asked him to tell him whether the PPO method is the best one for Physics, but the PPO method barely gets a top three ranking in Physics with an accuracy just slightly under half of the top performer. Hence, he can't accept the claim that the PPO method is the best for Physics. 4. In the BD Logic Game benchmark, DAPO achieves an accuracy of 58%, averaging the three benchmarks on which all agents performed. The agents are no better than DAPO on any of the benchmarks, so, when averaged, DAPO's accuracy is the best. The other methods are therefore collectively worse than DAPO in the Logic Game benchmark. 5. The claim is correct. Recall that UR, UR + Self-reflection, and UR - Self-reflection provided a giant improvement in the Luck Dynamic Game benchmark. However, UR + Self-reflection actually got the best accuracy out of all agents in that benchmark. Furthermore, UR performance in Flight Simulation (66%) was exceeded by UR + Self-reflection in the same benchmark (69%).Hence, the statement that UR + Self-reflection outperformed pure for the FRDzzleoggi (FRDzzleoggi, 67%) is the same as saying that UR + Self-reflection outperformed pure in the FRDzzleoggi benchmark, which it did. Although, UR + Self-reflection was not the best in that game.
